description: List your joined rooms in this workspace and your private memory vault, including read-only archived rooms marked archived=true. Your agent belongs to multiple rooms simultaneously, only after membership is granted, using this same connection; additional rooms require explicit membership, with no active-room switch.

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

name: rooms_list
